links.comparator_used: Store-and-forward teleophthalmology read by retina specialists (human consensus overread), both compared against in-person retina specialist examination
links.outcome: Sensitivity, specificity and gradability for more-than-mild diabetic retinopathy (MTMDR) in primary care screening
links.effect: AI sensitivity 95.5% (95% CI 86.7-100) vs 69.5% (95% CI 50.7-88.3) for retina specialists; specificity 60.3% (95% CI 47.7-72.9) vs 96.9% (95% CI 93.5-100); gradability 62.5% vs 93.1%; AI PPV 47.7%; MTMDR detected in 19.0% of gradable encounters in the AI phase vs 5.6% in the human phase
links.tradeoff: Lower specificity, with PPV under 50%, so many false-positive referrals. AI-ungradable rate of 36.5% in non-dilated patients, which can overwhelm referral pathways. The AI phase followed the human phase at the same sites. The in-person subset was not random, so PPV may be overestimated.
links.quote: The AI algorithm had higher sensitivity (95.5% sensitivity; 95% confidence interval [CI], 86.7%-100%) but lower specificity (60.3% specificity; 95% CI, 47.7%-72.9%) for detection of MTMDR compared with remote image interpretation by retina specialists (69.5% sensitivity; 95% CI, 50.7%-88.3%; 96.9% specificity; 95% CI, 93.5%-100%).

links.comparator_used: AI system alone for MTMDR-positive screening results, before referral for in-person examination.
links.outcome: Positive predictive value, accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity after routing AI-positive cases to retina specialist overread.
links.effect: AI alone PPV was 47.7%; 2-step AI-human overread increased PPV to 95.5% (95% CI, 86.7%–100%), accuracy to 97.4%, sensitivity was 95.5% (95% CI, 86.7%–100%), and specificity was 98.2% (95% CI, 94.6%–100%).
links.tradeoff: Requires an experienced retina specialist to overread all AI MTMDR-positive encounters before referral; no cost or latency was quantified.
links.quote: Under this 2-step workflow, the positive predictive value increased to 95.5% (95% CI, 86.7%–100%), along with accuracy of 97.4%, sensitivity of 95.5% (95% CI, 86.7%–100%), and specificity of 98.2% (95% CI, 94.6%–100%) ( Figs 6 , 15 ).

design_hint: AI-human hybrid workflow with human specialist overread of positive/ungradable AI cases
